verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a Support Agent that deflects questions using knowledge-base content, but nothing in the evidence mentions multilingual responses, language detection, or answering in other languages from English-only content. Multilingual support is a fair axis for a support platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English
